$comment: Single source of truth for the progress card and the README progress/roadmap sections. Edit, then run: node tools/progress.mjs

metrics.label: Hardening & completion programme
metrics.note: Access and session security through to the V0 feature set. Closed at 13 packages on 10 Oct 2026; the rest of the scope moved to client change batches and V1.

metrics.label: Client change batches delivered
metrics.note: Change requests from the operator since go-live, each one built, reviewed, regression-tested and deployed.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.detail: Next.js 16 + Prisma + Auth.js scaffold, first three roles, job offers, courses and affinity matching, ACAT and ECOE in the student profile, trainer role.

milestones.title: Public launch
milestones.detail: Live on 7 June. Unified contextual navigation, legal pages, residence CRM for training entities, trainer ↔ course matching, branded transactional email.

milestones.title: Security audit I
milestones.detail: Audit remediation (evaluation paywall, atomic writes, SSO, email verification), training modalities, catalogue filters, supervised labour profile.

milestones.title: Security audit II · real data
milestones.detail: Second audit fixed and deployed, password recovery, training-entity portal, bulk student import, move from demo data to the real catalogue.

milestones.title: 124-course catalogue · WP1
milestones.detail: Full CeSeA Formación catalogue imported with drift checks. Work package 1: versioned sessions, purpose-bound tokens, trusted client IP, entity validation, tests and acceptance harness.

milestones.title: WP2 to WP13 · security pass
milestones.detail: Onboarding and validation for every role, entity course catalogues and scheduling, the trainer network, company job and training plans, an admin audit log and V0/V1 feature gating. Third security pass: encrypted national IDs and bank details, hashed one-time tokens, CSP with nonces, account suspension and erasure.

milestones.title: Client change batches 1 to 6
milestones.detail: Two-account sign-up for companies and entities, team rosters with per-section view or edit roles, service-based course codes with one course per delivery mode and hours, audience criteria shared with the public course websites, a trainer directory paid in SkillPoints and an entity-to-trainer chat. Four in-platform assessments (behavioural, projective, cognitive and vocational) unlocked with SkillPoints by the student or their employer, with verified results on the profile that employers can review.

milestones.title: Client change batch 7
milestones.detail: Trainers and entities can withdraw a pending request or invitation. Trainers pick one to three professions from the job catalogue, which drives a per-course affinity score: entities add trainers to a course from a searchable list ordered by fit, and trainers see the courses of their entities that match them and ask to join, with the entity approving. Course catalogue rebuilt to fit any screen with a large per-course scheduling button, delivery mode and hours as two linked dropdowns, session hours capped by the course, and dates read as numbered sessions everywhere instead of a from-to range.

milestones.title: Client change batch 8
milestones.detail: Entities search trainers by job hierarchy: a sector brings every profession under it and a specialty shows each match with its sector. E-learning courses open and close on a date and time instead of sessions, and blended sessions are marked on-site or online. Entities and companies can ask each other to collaborate; once they agree, the company picks a course or the entity schedules one for it, which the company has to accept. Entities propose a trainer from the scheduling form, the trainer accepts or declines, and the trainer can be changed later but not once the course has started. FUNDAE-subsidised courses cannot be cancelled within three days of starting, dates are checked for consistency on every screen, repeated sections were brought together, roles and permissions sit in one place on both profiles, companies choose whether to share their internal profile with each entity, and entities offer assessments to partner companies, paid by the company in SkillPoints.

milestones.title: Client change batch 9
milestones.detail: Courses that have started, and FUNDAE-subsidised courses within three days of starting, are locked for date and trainer changes, and a subsidised course is cancelled by confirming the paperwork has been done. Trainers get released courses back on their board and do not see started ones. Session notes reach the trainer and the company, a company and the chosen trainer agree on dates when a course has none, and e-learning courses for one company can take students from elsewhere, shown to the company by name only. Collaboration requires the yearly training agreement, the notice to the workers' legal representatives is kept once a year per company, students choose whether entities see the courses they take on their own, and the trainer search understands whole professions. Any entity can offer the four assessments for a one-off SkillPoints licence, companies accept a quote in euros, and a trainer from the entity reviews and validates each report.

milestones.title: V1
milestones.detail: Meeting booking after a rejected validation, semantic matching, online payments and offer packs, automated ECOE validation, full back office, mobile app.
